name: Overspeeding
epl: @Name('Overspeeding') select e from Event as e where e.streamId='speed-1' and e.value>25

name: EngineOverheat
epl: @Name('EngineOverheat') select e from Event as e where e.streamId='engine-temp-1' and e.value>28

name: HighSpeedOverheat
epl: @Name('HighSpeedOverheat') select a as over, b as heat from pattern [every a=PatternRecordStream(patternName='Overspeeding') -> b=PatternRecordStream(patternName='EngineOverheat')]
